brand.slogan: Attendance, customers, documents, staff, safety and company assets in a single app.

home.etichetta: Your whole company in the cloud
home.titolo: Your whole company in one app, with one registry
home.sottotitolo: Activate the applications you need: attendance, CRM, documents, human resources, compliance and company assets work together on the same customers and employees, with a single login.

presenze.title: Attendance
presenze.text: Clock-ins, shifts, remote working, expenses and timesheets ready for payroll.

crm.title: CRM
crm.text: Leads, pipeline, agenda, PDF quotes and customer support.

documentale.title: Documents
documentale.text: Company archive and personnel documents, with acknowledgement and signature.

risorseUmane.title: Human resources
risorseUmane.text: Payslips and tax forms split and published automatically, training, onboarding and offboarding.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.text: Workplace safety and the GDPR record, with every deadline.

risorseAziendali.title: Company assets
risorseAziendali.text: Fleet, assigned equipment and bookings of desks, rooms and cars.

comuni.title: Shared features
comuni.text: Single deadline schedule, notifications, weekly AI summary and voice assistant.

insieme.title: All connected
insieme.text: A single registry of customers and employees shared by all applications.

home.passiTitolo: Up and running in three steps

registra.title: Register your company
registra.text: In a few minutes you have access and the basic data ready.

attiva.title: Activate the applications
attiva.text: Choose only the ones you need, or all of them: no installation needed.

lavora.title: Work together
lavora.text: Employees, sales people and administration use the same app, each with their own permissions.

home.chiusuraTitolo: Start with one application, add the others when you need them
home.chiusuraTesto: Your data stays: when you activate a new application you immediately find your customers and employees.

features.sottotitolo: Six integrated applications plus shared services, with one registry and a single login.

presenze.sottotitolo: Clock-ins, shifts and timesheets ready for payroll.

timbrature.title: Clock in anywhere
timbrature.text: From smartphone or computer, with the site QR code, at a shared kiosk with PIN or badge; location check and clock-ins even without a connection.

turni.title: Shifts and planning
turni.text: Shifts per department with minimum coverage, conflicts with holidays and leave highlighted, shift swaps between colleagues with approval.

smartWorking.title: Remote working
smartWorking.text: Signed individual agreements, a remote-working calendar and a weekly day limit.

richieste.title: Requests and approvals
richieste.text: Holidays, leave, overtime and time bank: every request reaches the department approver.

noteSpese.title: Expenses and mileage
noteSpese.text: Expenses with receipts attached and mileage refunds calculated on the employee's vehicles.

anomalie.title: Anomalies and days to fix
anomalie.text: Odd clock-ins, recurring delays and unbalanced days explained by AI, with an absence forecast.

commesse.title: Job costing
commesse.text: Timesheet hours at hourly cost plus expenses: costs and margin of every job, with a PDF report.

paghe.title: Monthly check and payroll export
paghe.text: Review the month's timesheets, approve them in bulk and export them in your payroll consultant's formats.

clienti.title: Customers, contacts and leads
clienti.text: A single registry with contact people, sales owner and privacy consent; a lead becomes a customer in one click.

pipeline.title: Opportunities and pipeline
pipeline.text: Drag-and-drop stages, value and probability, expected close date and the history of every move.

agenda.title: Agenda and reminders
agenda.text: Calls and meetings with their outcome, a reminder before they start and activities in your personal calendar.

preventivi.title: Quotes and offers
preventivi.text: Price list of products and services, discounts and VAT, PDF sent by email; an accepted offer becomes a won opportunity.

assistenza.title: Customer support
assistenza.text: Customer requests with priority, channel and assignee, response times and the history in the customer card.

report.title: Reports and export
report.text: Pipeline by stage and salesperson, won and lost by reason, lead conversion and lists in Excel.

visibilita.title: Visibility and reassignment
visibilita.text: Each salesperson sees their own customers, or everyone sees everything; when someone leaves, their deals move to a colleague.

documentale.sottotitolo: The company archive and personnel documents.

archivio.title: Organised archive
archivio.text: Folders, document types with expiry and retention, versions of the same document and a recycle bin.

ricerca.title: Search
ricerca.text: By title, type, employee, customer, year and the text inside the files.

personale.title: Personnel documents
personale.text: Restricted to the employee concerned and authorised staff; the same document to several employees, each with their own copy.

firma.title: Acknowledgement and signature
firma.text: Read confirmation or one-click electronic signature, with date, time and recorded evidence; see who has not read yet.

verbali.title: Reports for the other applications
verbali.text: Handover of goods and PPE, remote-working agreements: the report is generated as a PDF, signed and archived.

riservatezza.title: Permissions and access log
riservatezza.text: The company decides who sees personnel documents; every opening, download or deletion is logged.

spazio.title: Expiry and storage
spazio.text: Documents expiring or past their retention period are flagged; storage follows your plan, with a warning before it runs out.

cedolini.title: Payslips and tax forms in one go
cedolini.text: The firm or the company uploads a single PDF: the system splits it by tax code or employee number and flags the pages to assign.

portale.title: Employee area
portale.text: "My payslips": a notification for every new document, acknowledgement and a report of who has confirmed.

formazione.title: Training and skills
formazione.text: Course catalogue, certificates and acquired skills, with renewal dates in the deadline schedule.

onboarding.title: Onboarding and offboarding
onboarding.text: Joining and leaving checklists generated from the employment dates, with the steps falling due.

consegne.title: Documents to hand over or sign
consegne.text: Checklist items with a file are closed when the employee confirms or signs.

account.title: App account
account.text: Access created on hiring and disabled on termination, straight from the checklist.

compliance.sottotitolo: Workplace safety and privacy under control.

corsi.title: Mandatory safety training
corsi.text: Courses by job role, completed courses and renewals: the training status of every employee.

visite.title: Medical checks and fitness
visite.text: Results and due dates for administrators, health data encrypted and visible only to authorised staff.

dpi.title: PPE handover
dpi.text: Protective equipment handed over with a report and the employee's acknowledgement.

nomine.title: Appointments and risk assessment
nomine.text: Safety officers, representatives, supervisors and emergency staff with the appointee's acknowledgement; risk assessment documents and their due dates.

gdpr.title: Record of processing
gdpr.text: The GDPR record with Excel export, appointments and external processors with contract expiry.

violazioni.title: Data breach register
violazioni.text: Every breach with its 72-hour deadline in the schedule and a notice to administrators.

studio.title: Managed by your consultant
studio.text: The firm keeps the GDPR record and deadlines on behalf of its client companies.

risorseAziendali.sottotitolo: Vehicles, equipment and spaces: who has them and when.

flotta.title: Fleet
flotta.text: Vehicles, assignment to employees and fringe benefits, linked to the mileage refunds in Attendance.

scadenzeVeicoli.title: Vehicle deadlines
scadenzeVeicoli.text: Road tax, insurance, inspection, servicing and rental or leasing contracts in the deadline schedule.

multe.title: Fines and costs
multe.text: The driver is found from the assignment period and is notified of the fine.

beni.title: Assigned equipment
beni.text: PCs, phones, badges and tools with categories and warranty expiry.

consegne.title: Handover and return
consegne.text: A signed report on handover and return; on termination, the list of what must be given back.

prenotazioni.title: Bookings
prenotazioni.text: Desks, meeting rooms and pool cars without overlaps, also in your personal calendar.

comuni.sottotitolo: Services shared by all active applications.

scadenzario.title: Single deadline schedule
scadenzario.text: Deadlines from every application on one page and in the "Due soon" widget.

notifiche.title: Notifications and preferences
notifiche.text: In-app and email alerts, with preferences chosen by each user.

preseVisione.title: Acknowledgements
preseVisione.text: One read confirmation for payslips, reports and appointments; with Documents it becomes a signature with a report.

calendario.title: Personal calendar
calendario.text: Activities, bookings and deadlines in Google, Outlook or your phone calendar through an .ics feed.

riepilogo.title: Weekly AI summary
riepilogo.text: Every week a summary of what happened in the company and, for the firm, in all its client companies.

assistente.title: AI assistant and voice commands
assistente.text: Speak or type: clock in, request leave, open a customer or the page you need.

ticket.title: Support and manuals
ticket.text: Support tickets with answers suggested from the documentation and PDF manuals for every application.

pricing.sottotitolo: One plan with all six applications, or only the ones you need: start for free.
pricing.nota: Prices exclude VAT. The bundle includes attendance, CRM, documents, human resources, compliance and company assets; you can activate or deactivate an application at any time.

scelta.domanda: Do I have to activate all the applications?
scelta.risposta: No: activate only the ones you need and add the others whenever you want. The bundle gives you all six.

dati.domanda: Is data shared between the applications?
dati.risposta: Yes: customers, employees, sites and vehicles are a single registry, used by all active applications.

collegamenti.risposta: Yes: handover reports for equipment and PPE are signed in Documents, fleet vehicles are used for mileage refunds in Attendance and every deadline ends up in the same schedule.

installare.domanda: Do I need to install anything?
installare.risposta: No, it works from the browser and from your smartphone.

consulente.risposta: Yes, the firm follows your companies with its own login: it uploads payslips, manages the GDPR record and receives the weekly summary.

about.sottotitolo: Simple software for companies and for those who follow them.
about.paragrafo1: We believe attendance, customers, documents, staff, safety and company assets belong in the same place, without duplicate registries or spreadsheets to copy over.
about.paragrafo2: {{siteName}} is made for companies and firms that want clear tools, always up to date and accessible from anywhere.

semplice.title: Simple
semplice.text: Every function can be used without training.

vicino.title: Close to you
vicino.text: Support from people who know your work.

register.condizioni: By signing up you accept the terms of service.
register.inviata: Request sent: check your email to confirm.
register.esito: Your company is ready: you can log in.
